what: Plan adds the semantic-sprawl partition hook to SKILL.md, but Step 1c and Step 1d delegate their actual bodies to discussion-rounds.md
scenario_or_breakage: An orchestrator following the normative reference can complete clarifying questions and Round 1 without ever offering partition, even when user answers reveal multiple sub-features
suggested_fix: Update discussion-rounds.md Step 1c guidelines and Step 1d behavior to include the sprawl check after user answers and route Split through the named Split-path procedure

what: Gate B and post-plan discussion revisions are owned by reference files that currently only say re-emit ACTION=EMIT_PLAN and proceed
scenario_or_breakage: A revised plan can grow past soft or hard thresholds after accepted findings or discussion edits, but the threshold check is skipped because the normative revision paths do not call Step 2b.5
suggested_fix: Update approval-gates.md and discussion-rounds.md to invoke a shared named plan-size-check procedure after every plan.txt rewrite, before proceeding to Step 3b or Step 3

what: Step 5d proposes a runtime gh issue comment to hard-coded issue 2672
scenario_or_breakage: When larch runs as a plugin in a consumer checkout, bare gh issue comment 2672 targets the hub default repo, which can spam or leak workflow metadata to the wrong public issue
suggested_fix: Remove the runtime comment and keep the deferred L3 dependency in docs or PR notes; if a mechanical note is mandatory, gate it to larch development runs only, use an explicit --repo for the larch repo, and add a once-only sentinel

what: The proposed files-count implementation says grep -cE under set -e while also promising FILES_COUNT=0 for legacy plans with no headings
scenario_or_breakage: A literal Bash implementation aborts on grep exit 1 for zero matches, causing Step 2b.5 to warn and skip threshold detection instead of reporting FILES_COUNT=0
suggested_fix: Specify a no-match-safe implementation such as awk counting or grep -cE ... || true, and add a zero-heading harness case

what: The plan alternates between requiring a trailing diff_lines trailer and parsing the last matching diff_lines line anywhere in the file
scenario_or_breakage: A plan with prose containing diff_lines: 100 but no valid final trailer can be accepted by the new helper contract while emit-plan rejects it, creating drift between validators
suggested_fix: Align check-plan-size with emit-plan by requiring the final non-empty line to match diff_lines: <N>; document and test prose mentions plus a valid final trailer
